_comment: Edge case: /ask prompt contains two CVE identifiers. The entity extractor raises MultipleEntitiesError and the API returns HTTP 400 with an error message. Pipeline aborts before graph execution.

request.prompt: Compare CVE-2021-44228 and CVE-2021-45046 attack paths

errors: Multiple entities of type 'cveId' found: only single-entity queries are supported

notes: MultipleEntitiesError is raised by ai/entity_extractor.py and caught by orchestrator/api.py. The AI layer does not support multi-entity queries in the current release. Each query must anchor to a single CVE, CWE, ATT&CK technique, or CPE.
